gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine, paired against our own frozen candidate f10_omw_lock on identical opponents/seeds/seats. The change is a constant +30 coins, so it can only move W/L in worlds decided by less than that; the gate therefore asks for no W/L regression plus a measured margin gain: total paired score >= 0, score against the guarded public agent >= 75% and not below the control's, head to head against the control >= 50%, mean paired margin gain >= +15 coins over all games, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0 (one world, both seats), no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The Kaggle kernel then repeats the paired comparison on four fresh seeds against Metav4-family opponents (total > 0 and no opponent below the control). If it passes, f10_omwg_lock replaces f10_omw_lock as the Metav4-family slot; f10_v53_lock is unchanged. Registered before the run.
